documents.text: Kevin Lewis (footballer, born 1952) Kevin William Lewis (born 25 September 1952) was an English former footballer who played in the Football League for Crewe Alexandra and Stoke City. His nephew of the same name was also a footballer who played for Stoke City. Lewis was born in Hull and played in the youth teams of Manchester United before joining Stoke City in 1972. He never was really able to force his way into Tony Waddington's side and after 16 appearances in four seasons he left the Victoria Ground. He spent three years out of the game before joining Crewe
